hebrewText: חָלַ֥ק לִבָּ֖/ם עַתָּ֣ה יֶאְשָׁ֑מוּ ה֚וּא יַעֲרֹ֣ף מִזְבְּחוֹתָ֔/ם יְשֹׁדֵ֖ד מַצֵּבוֹתָֽ/ם

tokens.bdb: to be smooth (figuratively); by implication (as smooth stones were used for lots) to apportion or separate
tokens.kjv: deal, distribute, divide, flatter, give, (have, im-) part(-ner), take away a portion, receive, separate self, (be) smooth(-er).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to be smooth ; by implication  to apportion or separate
tokens.enLiteralWord: to be smooth ; by implication  to apportion or separate
tokens.explanation: to be smooth ; by implication  to apportion or separate
tokens.explanationEn: to be smooth ; by implication  to apportion or separate

tokens.bdb: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
tokens.kjv: [phrase] care for, comfortably, consent, [idiom] considered, courag(-eous), friend(-ly), ((broken-), (hard-), (merry-), (stiff-), (stout-), double) heart(-ed), [idiom] heed, [idiom] I, kindly, midst, mind(-ed), [idiom] regard(-ed), [idiom] themselves, [idiom] unawares, understanding, [idiom] well, willingly, wisdom.
tokens.enLiteralWord: the heart; also used  very widely for the feelings
tokens.explanation: lev — coração, mente, vontade, centro da vida interior
tokens.explanationEn: the heart; also used  very widely for the feelings

tokens.bdb: at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive
tokens.kjv: henceforth, now, straightway, this time, whereas.

tokens.bdb: to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish
tokens.kjv: [idiom] certainly, be(-come, made) desolate, destroy, [idiom] greatly, be(-come, found, hold) guilty, offend (acknowledge offence), trespass.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish
tokens.enLiteralWord: to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish
tokens.explanation: to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish
tokens.explanationEn: to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish

tokens.bdb: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.enLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanation: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanationEn: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self

tokens.bdb: to break the neck; hence (figuratively) to destroy
tokens.kjv: that is beheaded, break down, break (cut off, strike off) neck.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to break the neck; hence  to destroy
tokens.enLiteralWord: to break the neck; hence  to destroy
tokens.explanation: to break the neck; hence  to destroy
tokens.explanationEn: to break the neck; hence  to destroy

tokens.bdb: properly, to be burly, i.e. (figuratively) powerful (passively, impregnable); by implication, to ravage
tokens.kjv: dead, destroy(-er), oppress, robber, spoil(-er), [idiom] utterly, (lay) waste.

tokens.bdb: something stationed, i.e. a column or (memorial stone); by analogy, an idol
